lines.x: Listen well. I hereby formally appoint you as executive assistant to the heir of the de Toledo family, to aid me in rebuilding the glory of the Iberian Navy! Ahem, why are you just standing there? I'm giving you an excuse to escape work and you're not happy? Quick, run with me!

Descendant of a naval admiral, investor behind the Inquisition... my con-artist titles are beyond counting. In a village without even an Arbiter, I call all the shots. So, quick, assign me some people. I promised the villagers I'd fix their irrigation system. That's the first step to winning supporters.

Which business partner is giving you a headache this time? A hundred years ago, my family would have brought them to heel! Hehe, I got too into character. If I really were a noble... never mind. What use is learning to walk with an apple on your head? It doesn't earn hard cash, so it's worse than being an acrobat.

On a snowy night when the coast froze over, before the old man breathed his last, he passed his naval uniform to me with trembling hands, and my tears immediately... what? The last heavy snow in Iberia was twenty years ago? Sigh, if everyone were as nitpicky as you, how would I ever eat my fill!

Hey, hey, hey, I don't have to change out of these clothes, do I? I still need the de Toledo name to make a living. No more need for cons? The rising of the Port City will bring great change to Iberia? Are you serious... When I went through all that trouble charging into the sea to salvage it, I never thought about any of that.

Thanks for the kind thought, Doctor. But even Iberian scripture used for blessings only reminds me of the villagers' miserable faces. If life's rotten to the core, why not do something that makes you happy? Last time I sang a banned sea shanty in a tavern, at least some people danced along.

You want me to complete the contract paperwork? Not signing! Does a noble have to follow such rules? Even if you send me on the toughest mission, I won't refuse... but afterward you have to write me up in glowing terms in my evaluation report. Life on Rhodes Island is too comfortable, and my supporters are starting to suspect me.

What a lovely office. Roughing it on the floor for a night beats using a wooden boat as a windbreak. The cup really holds coffee, not muddy water, so you won't get sick drinking it all day. And there's a sturdy wardrobe, for when someone comes looking for trouble... hey, don't make that face. It's not some charity fundraiser.

Not a single true word in the report? You don't get it. It's a survival skill. I only got a full meal by falsely claiming a death benefit, and only got protection by perjuring myself under interrogation. I tell you I don't care at all what you think of me... because that's the only way I can convince myself to accept kindness.
If you really want to catch up on sleep, don't listen to the Iberian sea shanties I recorded for you. Doesn't the intro alone always wake you right up?

Estefanía Colón de Toledo, descendant of an Iberian naval admiral. Will you not salute... pfft, why are you more into this than I am? I can tell at a glance you're not easily fooled by titles. Don't tease me.
Wow, the rolled R I used to imitate a noble accent just now was absolutely awful. I need to practice properly. Can't let it slip next time I'm negotiating.
A promotion? So my words carry more weight now? All Rhodes Island Operators, hear my command: charge the Doctor's hood!

My old medals were all stripped off different dead men. They helped me plenty, but wearing them always weighed on my conscience a little. Now the problem's solved! From now on I can call myself a naval admiral under Rhodes Island, right?

New weapons of astonishing lethality! Unexpected battle plans! Safe and reliable support! Oh, I know there's nothing in the prep room. I'm just boosting the morale of our people who haven't come in yet, see?

I know this one well. Two friendly faces to win sympathy, one with a vicious glare to create conflict, and while the enemy's stunned I calmly make my entrance to mediate... wait, why have you all already picked up your weapons?
Follow the great descendant of the de Toledo family and write a legend!
Hey, if I can con all those enemies over there into joining our ranks, what'll you give me as a reward?
Bow your head, salute, keep a low posture... don't be mad at me. If you don't play along, won't this fake noble get exposed?
Wait, wait, the feather on my hat is crooked. Quick, help me fix it. Details make or break a con.
Don't go head-to-head with the elite troops under my command. Surrender is your only way out!
Don't even think of using me as your breakthrough point. If I retreat in front of my supporters, I'm really done for!
Seeking power? Drop that junk blade in your hand. Take your pick from the Rhodes Island weapons workshop's stock!
Seeking wealth? Leave your employer. The treasures of the Golden Age are buried in the saline fields where sugarcane grows!
You worship power? Become my follower, and when Iberia shines once more, you'll be one of its heroes!
Save your breath? I can't fool you? Sigh, being that clever is really not very clever at all.

This ancestral staff once clashed with a knight's silver lance amid raging waves, and it can summon countless specters to drag evildoers into the void. I advise you not to bring trouble on yourselves... what? The battle's already over?
Good work, Doctor. Leave the post-battle summary to me. No trouble? No, I mean if you do everything, I won't be able to keep my people!

There's an enemy camp two kilometers away, and they'll most likely set an ambush in the woods—hm? My source? A prisoner who surrendered told me. Oh, I forgot to mention, he's now an armorer for the de Toledo family.
Banging coconut shells on sand can imitate the sound of cavalry coming to reinforce us. The enemy definitely won't dare pursue recklessly. Don't worry, I've got plenty of experience.
It's been a long time since I've seen a place this well furnished... ah, no, I mean, if my family's estate were still around, I'd definitely invite you all over as guests.
The epaulettes are glued on, don't knock them off!
Perfect timing! In three seconds, you're the butler who watched me grow up. Got it?
Arknights.

On a day like today, why aren't you out dancing? Oh~ I get it, you want to experience something special. Come on, let me teach you how to get a smug profiteer to treat us to a feast without spending a single coin!
You want me to accompany you on patrol? Fine, I'll permit you to accompany me on patrol.

Go on, my most loyal assistant. Any gift you want, I can give you! Hey, what's that face? I'd never con my way into something I'm giving away. I'm just betting that you truly care for every Operator and wouldn't make things hard for me... did I bet right?

Look, how's the prose? This is a biography of us two written by the most creatively gifted clerk under me. Of course it's worth nothing if published now, but what if someday our meeting becomes a bold, vivid moment in Terran history? Right?
